options.name: allow_requests
options.description: Controls if IP requests are allowed for subnet

options.name: app_id
options.description: API app name

options.name: cidr
options.description: Network in CIDR format. Mutually exclusive with I(subnet) and I(mask).

options.name: description
options.description: Text which is shown in side bar if 'show as name' is selected

options.name: discover_subnet
options.description: Controls if new hosts should be discovered for new host scans

options.name: dns_records
options.description: Controls whether hostname DNS records are displayed

options.name: dns_recursive
options.description: Controls if PTR records should be created for subnet

options.name: folder
options.description: folder name which subnet belongs to

options.name: is_full
options.description: Marks subnet as used

options.name: linked_subnet
options.description: Linked ipv6 subnet in CIDR format

options.name: location
options.description: Subnet location

options.name: mask
options.description: Prefix length (bits) for ipv4 and ipv6 subnets. Mutually exclusive with I(cidr). If set. I(subnet) is required.

options.name: nameserver
options.description: Name of the DNS server which should attach to subnet

options.name: parent
options.description: CIDR of parent subnet

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user to access phpIPAM server

options.name: permissions
options.description: JSON object that represent the permissions for each user

options.name: ping_subnet
options.description: Controls if subnet should be included in status checks

options.name: routing_domain
options.description: Layer-2 routing domain the vlan belongs to If you have I(vlan) with same number in different routing domains it need to be set on desired value

options.name: scan_agent
options.description: Name of scanagent which should be used for subnet

options.name: section
options.description: Name of the section under which the subnet is located

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the phpIPAM server

options.name: show_as_name
options.description: If this is set to 'true' description is shown in side bar instead of CIDR

options.name: state
options.description: State of the entity

options.name: subnet
options.description: Network address Mutually exclusive with I(cidr). If set, I(mask) is required.

options.name: subnet_state
options.description: Assigned tag of the subnet.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Subnet threshold

options.name: username
options.description: Username to access phpIPAM server

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Is the TLS certificate of the phpIPAM server verified or not.

options.name: vlan
options.description: VLAN which the subnet should belongs to

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF which the subnet should belongs to
